shortDescription: Seven miner wallets transferred 350 bitcoin six hours ago, according to Lookonchain monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the bitcoins were mined by the wallets in March 2010.

title: Seven Miner Wallets Move 350 Bitcoin After 2010 Mining Rewards
